AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted database record for administrators who unlocked the Admin Panel with the secret passcode.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was unlocked.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public contributor profile for a registered SARAS book archivist (contains no PII).

uid.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name of the contributor.

phoneVerified.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contributor has verified their phone number via OTP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateContact.title: UserPrivateContact
UserPrivateContact.description: Isolated owner-only PII record storing the user's OTP-verified phone number.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 or formatted phone number verified via OTP.

phoneVerified.description: Must be true upon OTP verification.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when phone verification was recorded.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: An old book record containing 3-side photographs (front cover, spine, back cover), book title, book author, and contributor attribution.

title.description: The title/name of the old book.

author.description: The author name of the old book.

frontPhoto.description: Compressed image data URI for Side 1 (Front Cover).

spinePhoto.description: Compressed image data URI for Side 2 (Book Spine / Edge).

backPhoto.description: Compressed image data URI for Side 3 (Back Cover).

conditionNote.description: Optional brief condition or publication year note.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who photographed and added the book.

ownerName.description: Display name of the person who added the book.

visibility.description: Catalog visibility scope for query enforcement.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the book was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the book was last updated.

BookOrder.title: BookOrder
BookOrder.description: Order placed via Buy Now containing exact GPS/locality location, state, full Shiprocket delivery address, and sender phone number.

bookId.description: ID of the ordered book in /books/{bookId}.

sellerName.description: Name of the contributor who listed the book.

buyerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the buyer.

customerName.description: Recipient full name for Shiprocket delivery.

customerPhone.description: Phone number from which the order was sent.

exactLocation.description: Exact GPS coordinates and/or pinpointed locality string captured as step 1 of Buy Now.

fullAddress.description: House/Flat number, building, street, and locality for Shiprocket.

landmark.description: Optional nearby landmark plus automated phone call doubt/feedback and price notes.

state.description: Delivery state or union territory for Shiprocket.

pincode.description: Postal / PIN code for Shiprocket courier routing.

adminEmail.description: Bootstrapped administrator email for secure admin list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was placed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when order was last updated.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores trusted administrator records keyed by UID.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public non-PII contributor profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated owner-only PII subcollection storing the contributor's OTP-verified phone number.

/books/{bookId}.description: Stores cataloged old books with 3-side photos, book name, author name, and contributor info.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores Buy Now book orders with exact location, state, phone number, and Shiprocket delivery details accessible only to the buyer and the administrator.
